U3-err-connector.keychain_refused.en: Clauseo couldn't read your saved case-law sign-in on this computer, so nothing was changed. If this computer asks for permission, choose Allow, then try again.
U3-err-connector.keychain_refused.note: connector.keychain_refused (#1348): the keychain refused case law's saved sign-in (on a Mac, Deny, or another build's item), so the lawyer's Sign out, Sign in or Add key (Mac only), or a balance read or recharge (every OS), changed nothing. Also a key's Sign out whose delete the keychain refused (no revoke was asked for). Not a Sign out whose delete was refused after a revoke: that is internal, as nothing-was-changed would be untrue. Remove never shows it: it forgets case law here and sets ConnectorView.left_in_keychain, whose line the app track writes. Provisional, not approved.
